description.text: National Strategy for School Security Act of 2025 This bill requires the Department of Homeland Security (DHS) to develop a national strategy to secure elementary and secondary schools from acts of terrorism. DHS must submit this strategy to Congress, annually update the strategy (if appropriate) through 2033, and provide annual briefings to Congress on those updates.

latestAction.text: Read twice and referred to the Committee on Homeland Security and Governmental Affairs.

bill.title: National Strategy for School Security Act of 2025

aiDescription.summary: The bill requires DHS to submit within one year a national strategy to secure K-12 schools from terrorism and to update or certify it annually through 2033. The strategy must list federal programs and spending, identify vulnerabilities and goals, propose actions and resources, and coordinate with Education and other agencies.

impact.summary: The bill requires the Department of Homeland Security, with the Department of Education, to produce and update a national strategy securing elementary and secondary schools from terrorism. The strategy must inventory federal programs and spending and guide FEMA grants and state and local school districts.
